objective: Test the v36-derived sensitivity hypothesis without another search: apply one fixed rank-16 INT8 calibration-span residual to layers whose frozen base validation NMSE is at least 0.001, bypass lower-error layers exactly, and score the frozen candidate once on the still-unmaterialized holdout.

base_candidate.representation: the exact frozen three-layer trained CQ3 MLP plus AFF3 attention-output payloads from the prior mixed experiment

sensitivity_rule.input_statistic: v36 frozen internal-validation base trained-mixed complete-block NMSE
sensitivity_rule.selection_interpretation: The residual is admitted only where the frozen base error is large enough to support a validation-stable correction. The low-error layer is not forced through a learned map.

fixed_adapter.selection_from_v36_only: Rank 16 is the smallest tested rank whose layer-63 relative validation reduction exceeds 0.35 while layer 0 exceeds 0.19. At rank 16, ridge 0.01 has the lowest arithmetic-mean corrected NMSE across the two sensitivity-admitted layers.
fixed_adapter.int8_quantization: symmetric per-rank-component scales: per-column for left and per-row for right; recompute combined bias after factor quantization
fixed_adapter.native_kernel_target: fused AVX2 INT8 rank-16 skinny residual with exact bypass for non-admitted layers

fresh_confirmation.provenance: The exact four texts were frozen for v36 but the cache was never materialized or scored because v36 stopped at calibration. v37 reuses this untouched predeclared holdout.
texts: A warehouse ships 128 boxes in equal groups to 8 stores. Compute the boxes per store and state one check on the result.
Give language-agnostic pseudocode for stable deduplication of a list while preserving the first occurrence of each value.
Explica en espanol, en dos frases, por que una medicion repetible es mas confiable que una sola anecdota.
A log record contains user_id, event_time, duration_ms, and outcome. Describe a deterministic filter for successful events slower than 750 milliseconds.
fresh_confirmation.evaluation_contamination_forbidden: No CUTE, MATH-500, code-trace, MMLU, WikiText, prior confirmation tensor, or copied benchmark item may enter fitting or confirmation.

training.refit: Fit rank-16 ridge-0.01 adapters on all 64 frozen calibration rows for layers 0 and 63 only, quantize and hash them, and create no payload for bypass layer 32.

execution_policy.checkpoint_limit: two final adapter payloads plus terminal receipts and one small confirmation cache; retain no optimizer or grid checkpoints

sequential_rule: Freeze v37, materialize and hash the two fixed adapters without a grid, then collect the previously declared but never materialized holdout and score exactly the frozen base and frozen sensitivity-gated candidate once.
next_if_passed: Implement and benchmark the exact rank-16 fused AVX2 residual kernel with a zero-cost bypass, then expand sensitivity classification one restartable layer at a time before any whole-model conversion claim.
claim_boundary: A pass establishes a three-block sensitivity-gated geometric correction signal and deployable projection only. It is not a whole-model quality or speed result, does not establish 2.75 or 100 tok/s, and does not support novelty, lossless, DFlash3, or scientific-breakthrough claims.
